title: Shoprite workers’ strike and protest in Luanda
location: Luanda Province; an unnumbered concentration is reported at Shoprite’s Palanca store. A company-headquarters demonstration is mentioned without a precise site.
participants_original: An employee representative claimed more than 70% of Shoprite workers joined; no denominator or absolute headcount is supplied. The article also calls the Palanca concentration large without a number.
threshold_50_evidence: Not established. The 70% statement concerns an unspecified workforce denominator, not an assembly count; the reported concentration is unnumbered.
organizer: Shoprite employees and a worker committee/union organizing body; the employer disputes the committee’s legal status.
demand_text: Workers cite long hours, alleged mistreatment and unjust dismissals, and request health, food and transport benefits and wage increases.
demand_target: Shoprite Group Angola/private employer; no demand directed at the domestic government or a public policy is reported.
tactic: Three-day strike and workplace protest/concentration reported; article says it was to run through 28 January, but does not confirm completion.
exclusion_reason: Does not meet the unit’s stated inclusion scope: the demands reported target a private employer rather than domestic government/public policy, and evidence does not establish an assembly of at least 50 people.

start_date.evidence: Article dated 26 January says workers began the strike that Thursday.

end_date.evidence: A three-day period through 28 January is announced; actual completion is unknown.

location.evidence: Article places the action in Luanda Province and reports an unnumbered concentration at the Palanca store.

participants.evidence: Organizer claims over 70% of the workforce joined without denominator; absolute turnout and threshold remain unknown.

demands.evidence: Workers seek workplace benefits and wage changes and complain of long hours, alleged mistreatment and dismissals.

demand_target.evidence: Reported demands are addressed to Shoprite management, not government or public policy.

tactic.evidence: Article reports a strike and concentration/protest at a workplace.

protester_violence.evidence: No protester violence is reported; absence is not established.

state_response.evidence: Police were reportedly called to the location, but no response matching any coded dimension is described; all seven values remain unknown.

open_questions: Was any gathering of 50 or more present at the Palanca store or company headquarters?
Did the strike end on 28 January as planned?
No public-policy or government-directed demand is evident in the available report.
readiness: excluded_after_one_report; no independent corroboration sought yet
